Triage Gate.rationale: bug-analysis validated 30/30 on first attempt; severity medium, deterministic. The analyst measured all 89 committed instances across 13 types with a read-only probe: exactly one (type, instance) pair lacks the anchor (orchestration-result in run-d8937789961e), and the previous triage's mechanism claim is corrected: the trigger is identifier rendering without backticks, not a gate row of none. omn-dev-1-bug-analyst produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.

Fix Gate.decided_by: omn-dev-2-reviewer subagent, recorded by session operator
Fix Gate.rationale: Reviewer verdict approve-with-corrections, no critical or high findings, every finding backed by a command it ran. Rationale recorded verbatim: The change removes both causes the root-cause analysis established. The orchestration row is now found by its identifier cell under the contract engine's optional-backtick rule, and each type's instance is the first candidate the declared mutation applies to, with skips reported. On unchanged run evidence the verifier moves from the reproduced 5/6 failure to 6/6, using the plain-rendered run-d8937789961e closure record caught by O4. Scoped probes of main() confirm that V4 still fails for an accept-all validator, a wrong-check validator, and a type with no applicable candidate, so decisiveness is preserved. The ten new tests fail on a reconstructed pre-fix verifier, five of them on behaviour rather than on shape, and pass on the fix. No consumer of the JSON output or of conforming_instance exists beyond the test module. Two non-blocking defects remained: a candidate skipped for lacking an anchor was never validated by V3 (F-001, medium, not reachable on current evidence), and one new test asserted a tree-wide V3 pass so it failed from inside the framework directory (F-002, low). Subsequently closed by a correction pass by omn-dev-1-implement: V3 now validates every skipped candidate (a new test reproduces the reviewer's exit-0 case and fails before the correction), and the test no longer depends on the working directory. Operator re-verified after the corrections: verify_validators 6/6, 26 of 26 tests in the module, the working-directory case passes from inside the framework directory, mirror byte-identical, full unit suite 668 of 668 via the parallel runner. omn-dev-1-implement produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.

Verification Gate.rationale: validation-report validated 31/31; verdict pass, 8 of 8 criteria met on commands QA executed: verify_validators 6/6 with the orchestration-result row caught by O4 on the real unbackticked closure record and no candidate skipped; original verifier gives 5/6 on the same tree; 26 of 26 tests including the working-directory-sensitive classes from inside the framework directory; seven pinning tests for V4 decisiveness and V3 coverage of used and skipped candidates; locator accepts both identifier styles; registry coverage 8/8, manifests 2/2, bundle parity 11 OK, mirror byte-identical; full suite 668 of 668 executed independently by the operator and by QA. Unmitigated risk R-001 recorded for the proposal: V4 can pass on an older instance while a newer one goes unmutated (skips are printed and stored in the JSON). omn-qa produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.

Closure Gate.rationale: Five phases executed, five artifacts validated by their registered validators on first attempt each (30/30, 30/30, 32/32, 31/31, 34/34), zero charged retries, three prior gates decided by non-producing owners with a second independently dispatched reviewer whose every finding was backed by an executed command; closure produced at tier light without escalation. verify_validators V4 is now repaired for the class (selection applicability, locator parity with the contract engine, V3 over skipped candidates), 6/6, full suite 668 of 668 executed independently three times. Recorded disclosures: R-001 unmitigated risk (V4 may pass on an older instance while a newer one goes unmutated; skips printed and stored), cwd-dependent V3 F7 failure out of scope, implementation report counts 25 tests / 667 versus actual 26 / 668 after the post-review pass. omn-orchestrator produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.
